summary: Some DHCP options carry unique identifiers that can enable tracking even when other identifiers are randomized. This standards-track RFC defines anonymity profiles for clients that want to remain anonymous on a visited network, with guidelines on composing DHCP and DHCPv6 messages to minimize identifying information.

eli5.summary: Walking into a new building without a name tag. This tells devices what to leave out when asking for network settings so they are harder to follow.
